name: Kimodo SOMA RP
description: Kimodo SOMA RP human motion generation for Modly. Generates text-driven humanoid motion artifacts and returns a compatibility GLB preview.
author: DrHepa

nodes.name: Text to Motion Preview
nodes.description: Generates a Kimodo motion bundle and returns a compatibility GLB preview for Modly.

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Prompt text forwarded to Kimodo. Runtime-core supports the single-prompt baseline only.

params_schema.label: Duration (s)
params_schema.tooltip: Motion duration in seconds. Kimodo supports up to 10 seconds per prompt.

params_schema.label: Diffusion Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of Kimodo denoising steps. Higher values are slower.

params_schema.label: Samples
params_schema.tooltip: Number of motion samples to generate. The first sample is used for the GLB preview.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Use -1 for an unseeded run. Non-negative values are forwarded to Kimodo for reproducibility.

params_schema.label: Constraints JSON
params_schema.tooltip: Optional path to a Kimodo constraints JSON file.

params_schema.label: Export BVH
params_schema.tooltip: Also export BVH alongside the canonical NPZ when available.

params_schema.label: Disable Postprocess
params_schema.tooltip: Runtime-core defaults to no postprocess because MotionCorrection is intentionally skipped in setup.

params_schema.label: Text Encoder Device
params_schema.tooltip: TEXT_ENCODER_DEVICE override for Kimodo. CPU is the safest runtime-core baseline.

nodes.name: Animate Rigged Mesh
nodes.description: Generates a Kimodo BVH/NPZ motion bundle and attempts a real root-translation MVP animated GLB export for a supplied rigged mesh. UniRig humanoid rigs are recommended; Load Mesh rigged GLB/GLTF inputs are accepted; non-humanoid rigs are best-effort.
